{{Quote|End of the line, Fett!|Rac|<ref name="You Can Draw" />}}
'''Rac''' was a young, [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]].<ref name="You Can Draw" />

Seeking revenge for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of a number of Jedi on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="You Can Draw" /> a [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] beyond [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Rac tracked the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, she confronted him in a vendor alley, drawing her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Familiar with Rac, Fett remarked that he should have killed her along with the other Jedi on Kamino.<ref name="You Can Draw" /> Fett survived the encounter, eventually falling to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Rac had dark hair and fair skin, wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], and carried a lightsaber.<ref name="You Can Draw" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rac first appeared in the [[2007]] book ''[[You Can Draw: Star Wars]]'', drawn by [[Matt Busch]] and written by [[Bonnie Burton]]. She featured in ''Jango Fett: Scum and Villainy'' #X, a sample script used to illustrate the comic-making process.<ref name="You Can Draw" />
